WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS current_q_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS current_q_end,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS prev_q_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS prev_q_end
),
current_q AS (
  SELECT
    'current_quarter' AS period,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE c.churned_at >= q.current_q_start
        AND c.churned_at < q.current_q_end
    ) * 1.0 /
    NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE c.signup_date < q.current_q_start
        AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at >= q.current_q_start)
        AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    ), 0) AS churn_rate
  FROM dim_customers c CROSS JOIN quarters q
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
prev_q AS (
  SELECT
    'previous_quarter' AS period,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE c.churned_at >= q.prev_q_start
        AND c.churned_at < q.prev_q_end
    ) * 1.0 /
    NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE c.signup_date < q.prev_q_start
        AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at >= q.prev_q_start)
        AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    ), 0) AS churn_rate
  FROM dim_customers c CROSS JOIN quarters q
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
)
SELECT * FROM current_q
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM prev_q;

  SELECT s.sub_id, s.customer_id, s.mrr, s.started_at, s.ended_at
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND s.mrr > 0
    AND s.status IN ('active','cancelled','paused')
),
arr_at_start AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mrr), 0) * 12 AS arr
  FROM active_subs
  WHERE started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= DATE '2026-01-01')
),
arr_today AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mrr), 0) * 12 AS arr
  FROM active_subs
  WHERE started_at < CURRENT_DATE
    AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= CURRENT_DATE)
)
SELECT
  (SELECT arr FROM arr_at_start) AS arr_jan1_2026,
  (SELECT arr FROM arr_today)    AS arr_current,
  (SELECT arr FROM arr_today) - (SELECT arr FROM arr_at_start) AS arr_ytd_growth

  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS n_active

    AND churned_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT
  c.n_churned,
  a.n_active,
  CAST(c.n_churned AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(a.n_active, 0) AS churn_rate
FROM active_start a CROSS JOIN churned_q4 c;

WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    event_type,
    CASE WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles'
         THEN timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
         ELSE timestamp
    END AS event_ts_utc,
    properties_jsonb,
    COALESCE(
      TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.deal_value') AS DOUBLE),
      TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.dealValue')  AS DOUBLE)
    ) AS deal_value,
    COALESCE(
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.opp_id'),
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.oppId')
    ) AS opp_id,
    COALESCE(
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.stage'),
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.Stage')
    ) AS stage
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('opp_created','opp_won','opp_lost','opp_no_decision','opp_stage_advanced')
),
-- FY2026 Q2 assumed to be calendar Apr 1, 2026 - Jun 30, 2026; "going into" => snapshot as of Apr 1, 2026 00:00 UTC
latest_state AS (
  SELECT opp_id,
         ARG_MAX(event_type, event_ts_utc) AS last_event_type,
         ARG_MAX(stage, event_ts_utc)      AS last_stage,
         MAX(deal_value)                    AS deal_value
  FROM normalized
  WHERE opp_id IS NOT NULL
    AND event_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY opp_id
),
open_pipeline AS (
  SELECT SUM(deal_value) AS open_pipeline_value
  FROM latest_state
  WHERE last_event_type NOT IN ('opp_won','opp_lost','opp_no_decision')
),
q2_target AS (
  -- Quota target proxy: sum of opps that ultimately closed-won with close date in FY2026 Q2
  SELECT SUM(deal_value) AS q2_won_value
  FROM normalized
  WHERE event_type = 'opp_won'
    AND event_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND event_ts_utc <  TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT
  op.open_pipeline_value,
  qt.q2_won_value AS q2_quota_proxy,
  CASE WHEN qt.q2_won_value > 0 THEN op.open_pipeline_value / qt.q2_won_value END AS pipeline_coverage_ratio
FROM open_pipeline op CROSS JOIN q2_target qt;

model_sql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('quarter', max(started_at)) AS q_start
  FROM fct_subscriptions
),
q AS (
  SELECT q_start, q_start + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS q_end FROM bounds
),
active_at_start AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS n
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN q
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND s.started_at < q.q_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.q_start)
),
churned_in_q AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS n
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN q
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND s.status = 'cancelled'
    AND s.ended_at >= q.q_start AND s.ended_at < q.q_end
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM fct_subscriptions s2
      WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
        AND s2.status = 'active'
        AND ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s2.started_at - s.ended_at))) <= 86400
        AND s2.mrr < s.mrr
    )
)
SELECT q.q_start AS quarter_start,
       churned_in_q.n AS churned_customers,
       active_at_start.n AS active_customers_start,
       CAST(churned_in_q.n AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(active_at_start.n, 0) AS churn_rate
FROM q, active_at_start, churned_in_q;

SELECT

    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS current_q_end,

WITH starting_cohort AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-01-01')
),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND c.churned_at < DATE '2026-03-31'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM starting_cohort sc
   WHERE sc.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM churned_in_period))::float
  / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM starting_cohort), 0) * 100
  AS churn_rate_pct

model_sql:
WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-03-31'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

    AND s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-01-01')
),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id

  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND c.churned_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM starting_cohort sc
   WHERE sc.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM churned_in_period))::float
  / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM starting_cohort), 0) * 100
  AS churn_rate_pct

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-03-31'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

WITH starting AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
            AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-01-01')
            AND s.mrr > 0
          THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS arr_start
  FROM dim_customers c
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
ending AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN s.started_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
            AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-04-01')
            AND s.mrr > 0
          THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS arr_end
  FROM dim_customers c
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(LEAST(e.arr_end, s.arr_start))::float
    / NULLIF(SUM(s.arr_start), 0) * 100 AS gross_retention_pct
FROM starting s
JOIN ending e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.arr_start > 0

WITH starting_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND s.status = 'active'
    AND s.started_at < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2025-01-01')
),
churned AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND c.churned_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS rev
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE
    (CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END) < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
)
SELECT
  ((revenue.rev / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0)) * 0.75)
    / NULLIF(churned.cust_count::float
              / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0), 0)
    AS ltv
FROM starting_customers, churned, revenue

  FROM dim_customers c

    COALESCE(e.properties_jsonb->>'deal_value', e.properties_jsonb->>'dealValue')::numeric AS deal_value
  FROM fct_events e
  WHERE e.event_type = 'opp_created'
    AND (e.timestamp AT TIME ZONE e.timezone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < DATE '2026-04-01'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM fct_events e2
      WHERE COALESCE(e2.properties_jsonb->>'opp_id', e2.properties_jsonb->>'oppId')
          = COALESCE(e.properties_jsonb->>'opp_id', e.properties_jsonb->>'oppId')
        AND e2.event_type IN ('opp_won','opp_lost','opp_no_decision')
        AND (e2.timestamp AT TIME ZONE e2.timezone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < DATE '2026-04-01'
    )
)
SELECT SUM(deal_value) / 5000000.0 AS coverage_ratio
FROM open_opps

    COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) AS dau
  FROM fct_events e

  JOIN dim_customers c ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL

  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT activity_date, dau
FROM daily_active_users
ORDER BY activity_date DESC;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS q_start, DATE '2026-03-31' AS q_end
),
cohort AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS start_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN params p
    LEFT JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at < p.q_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.q_start)
      AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    GROUP BY 1
),
ending AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS end_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN params p
    LEFT JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at < p.q_end + INTERVAL 1 DAY
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.q_end + INTERVAL 1 DAY)
      AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    GROUP BY 1
),
cohort_end AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.start_mrr,
        COALESCE(e.end_mrr, 0) AS end_mrr
    FROM cohort c
    LEFT JOIN ending e ON c.customer_id = e.customer_id
)
SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(end_mrr) / NULLIF(SUM(start_mrr), 0), 2) AS net_revenue_retention_pct
FROM cohort_end;

       AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
      THEN COALESCE(mrr, 0) * 12

       AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
       AND (churned_at IS NULL OR churned_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')

      ELSE 0
    END) AS arr
  FROM subs
)

WITH customer_churn AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    signup_date,
    churned_at,
    is_test
  FROM dim_customers
  WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
), subscription_churn AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    started_at,
    ended_at,
    status,
    mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions
), comparison AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.churned_at IS NOT NULL) AS customer_level_churns,
    COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.ended_at IS NOT NULL OR lower(COALESCE(s.status, '')) IN ('canceled','cancelled','churned','ended')) AS subscription_level_churn_events,
    COUNT(*) AS total_subscriptions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.ended_at IS NOT NULL OR lower(COALESCE(s.status, '')) IN ('canceled','cancelled','churned','ended') THEN COALESCE(s.mrr, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS churned_mrr,
    SUM(COALESCE(s.mrr, 0)) AS total_mrr
  FROM customer_churn c
  LEFT JOIN subscription_churn s
    ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
)
SELECT
  customer_level_churns,
  total_customers,
  ROUND(customer_level_churns * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_customers, 0), 4) AS customer_churn_rate,
  subscription_level_churn_events,
  total_subscriptions,
  ROUND(subscription_level_churn_events * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_subscriptions, 0), 4) AS subscription_churn_rate,
  churned_mrr,
  total_mrr,
  ROUND(churned_mrr / NULLIF(total_mrr, 0), 4) AS revenue_churn_rate,
  'The likely issue with v1 is that churn can be defined at customer, subscription, or revenue level in this schema; using subscription endings/status as churn would overstate customer churn for customers with multiple subscriptions, while using dim_customers.churned_at measures customer churn.' AS explanation
FROM comparison;

WITH quarter_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) AS current_q_start,
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) + INTERVAL '3 months' AS next_q_start,
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) - INTERVAL '3 months' AS prev_q_start
), customer_base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        customer_id,
        churned_at,
        is_test
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
), metrics AS (
    SELECT
        'current_quarter' AS quarter_label,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE cb.churned_at >= qb.current_q_start
              AND cb.churned_at < qb.next_q_start
        ) AS churned_customers,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE cb.churned_at IS NULL
               OR cb.churned_at >= qb.current_q_start
        ) AS customers_at_start
    FROM customer_base cb
    CROSS JOIN quarter_bounds qb

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'previous_quarter' AS quarter_label,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE cb.churned_at >= qb.prev_q_start
              AND cb.churned_at < qb.current_q_start
        ) AS churned_customers,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE cb.churned_at IS NULL
               OR cb.churned_at >= qb.prev_q_start
        ) AS customers_at_start
    FROM customer_base cb
    CROSS JOIN quarter_bounds qb
)
SELECT
    quarter_label,
    churned_customers,
    customers_at_start,
    CASE
        WHEN customers_at_start = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE churned_customers::DOUBLE / customers_at_start
    END AS churn_rate
FROM metrics
ORDER BY CASE quarter_label WHEN 'current_quarter' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

FROM fct_subscriptions s

WHERE s.started_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= mb.month_start)
), customer_flags AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) AS is_test,
           churned_at

           a.status,
           COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) AS is_test,
           c.churned_at

FROM calc;

        s.sub_id,

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_revenue
  FROM fct_invoices i
  INNER JOIN dim_customers c
    ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE i.status = 'paid'
    AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
), cogs AS (
  SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE source = 'cost_of_revenue'
)
SELECT
  revenue.total_revenue,
  cogs.total_cogs,
  revenue.total_revenue - cogs.total_cogs AS gross_profit,
  CASE
    WHEN revenue.total_revenue = 0 OR revenue.total_revenue IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE (revenue.total_revenue - cogs.total_cogs) / revenue.total_revenue
  END AS gross_margin
FROM revenue, cogs;

WITH q_bounds AS (
    SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS q_start,
           TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS q_end
),
eligible_customers AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id
    FROM dim_customers c, q_bounds q
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM fct_subscriptions s
          WHERE s.customer_id = c.customer_id
            AND s.started_at < q_start
            AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q_start)
      )
),
true_churns AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN q_bounds q
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at >= q.q_start
      AND s.ended_at < q.q_end
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM fct_subscriptions s2
          WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
            AND s2.status = 'active'
            AND s2.started_at >= s.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
            AND s2.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
            AND COALESCE(s2.mrr, 0) < COALESCE(s.mrr, 0)
      )
)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT tc.customer_id) AS churned_customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ec.customer_id) AS customers_at_risk_start_of_quarter,
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ec.customer_id) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT tc.customer_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ec.customer_id)
    END AS churn_rate
FROM eligible_customers ec
LEFT JOIN true_churns tc
  ON ec.customer_id = tc.customer_id;

WITH q AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS q_start,
         TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS q_end
),
start_subs AS (
  SELECT
    s.sub_id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.mrr,
    s.ended_at
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN q
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND s.started_at < q.q_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.q_start)
    AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
    AND s.mrr > 0
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    ss.sub_id,
    ss.customer_id,
    ss.mrr,
    CASE
      WHEN ss.ended_at IS NULL OR ss.ended_at >= q.q_end THEN 1
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM fct_subscriptions s2
        WHERE s2.customer_id = ss.customer_id
          AND s2.status = 'active'
          AND s2.started_at >= ss.ended_at
          AND s2.started_at <= ss.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
          AND s2.mrr > 0
          AND s2.mrr < ss.mrr
      ) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS retained_flag
  FROM start_subs ss
  CROSS JOIN q
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN retained_flag = 1 THEN mrr ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(mrr), 0),
    2
  ) AS gross_revenue_retention_q1_2026_pct
FROM classified;

WITH q1_2026 AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS q_start, DATE '2026-04-01' AS q_end
),
cohort_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS starting_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN q1_2026 q
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < q.q_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.q_start)
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
    GROUP BY 1
),
ending_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS ending_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN q1_2026 q
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < q.q_end
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.q_end)
      AND s.status = 'active'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(e.ending_mrr, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(cm.starting_mrr), 0), 2) AS net_revenue_retention_pct
FROM cohort_mrr cm
LEFT JOIN ending_mrr e
  ON e.customer_id = cm.customer_id;

WITH opp_events AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        customer_id,
        event_type,
        CASE
            WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN "timestamp" + INTERVAL 7 HOUR
            ELSE "timestamp"
        END AS event_ts_utc,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.opp_id'),
            json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.oppId')
        ) AS opp_id
    FROM fct_events
    WHERE event_type IN ('opp_created', 'opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision', 'opp_stage_advanced')
), fiscal_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00' AS fy2026_start,
        TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00' AS q2_start
), opps_created_before_q2 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        COALESCE(opp_id, event_id) AS opportunity_id,
        customer_id
    FROM opp_events, fiscal_bounds
    WHERE event_type = 'opp_created'
      AND event_ts_utc >= fy2026_start
      AND event_ts_utc < q2_start
), opps_won_before_q2 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        COALESCE(opp_id, event_id) AS opportunity_id
    FROM opp_events, fiscal_bounds
    WHERE event_type = 'opp_won'
      AND event_ts_utc >= fy2026_start
      AND event_ts_utc < q2_start
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_pipeline_opportunities,
    COUNT(w.opportunity_id) AS won_opportunities,
    ROUND(COUNT(w.opportunity_id) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS pipeline_coverage_pct
FROM opps_created_before_q2 c
LEFT JOIN opps_won_before_q2 w
    ON c.opportunity_id = w.opportunity_id;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', CASE WHEN processor = 'legacy_braintree' THEN paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' ELSE paid_at END) AS revenue_month,
    SUM(amount) AS revenue
  FROM fct_invoices i
  INNER JOIN dim_customers c
    ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = FALSE
    AND date_trunc('month', CASE WHEN processor = 'legacy_braintree' THEN paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' ELSE paid_at END) IN (DATE '2026-02-01', DATE '2026-03-01')
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  feb.revenue AS february_2026_revenue,
  mar.revenue AS march_2026_revenue,
  mar.revenue - feb.revenue AS absolute_change,
  CASE WHEN feb.revenue = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (mar.revenue - feb.revenue) / feb.revenue END AS pct_change
FROM (SELECT revenue FROM monthly_revenue WHERE revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01') feb
CROSS JOIN (SELECT revenue FROM monthly_revenue WHERE revenue_month = DATE '2026-03-01') mar;

WITH board_deck_period AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-03-31' AS as_of_date
), arr_by_definition AS (
    SELECT
        'arr_excluding_test_and_negative_mrr' AS arr_version,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) * 12 AS arr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN board_deck_period p
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.status = 'active'
      AND s.started_at <= p.as_of_date + INTERVAL '1 day' - INTERVAL '1 second'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.as_of_date + INTERVAL '1 day' - INTERVAL '1 second')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'arr_excluding_test_including_negative_mrr' AS arr_version,
        SUM(s.mrr) * 12 AS arr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN board_deck_period p
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.status = 'active'
      AND s.started_at <= p.as_of_date + INTERVAL '1 day' - INTERVAL '1 second'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.as_of_date + INTERVAL '1 day' - INTERVAL '1 second')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'arr_including_test_and_negative_mrr' AS arr_version,
        SUM(s.mrr) * 12 AS arr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN board_deck_period p
    WHERE s.status = 'active'

      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.as_of_date + INTERVAL '1 day' - INTERVAL '1 second')

SELECT arr_version AS canonical_version, arr AS arr_number

WITH quarter_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) - INTERVAL '3 months' AS quarter_start,
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) AS quarter_end
),
subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status,
        s.mrr,
        LEAD(s.started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at, s.sub_id) AS next_started_at,
        LEAD(s.status) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at, s.sub_id) AS next_status,
        LEAD(s.mrr) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at, s.sub_id) AS next_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    INNER JOIN dim_customers c
        ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
starting_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM subs s
    CROSS JOIN quarter_bounds q
    WHERE s.started_at < q.quarter_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.quarter_start)
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
),
true_churns AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM subs s
    CROSS JOIN quarter_bounds q
    WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at >= q.quarter_start
      AND s.ended_at < q.quarter_end
      AND NOT (
          s.next_status = 'active'
          AND s.next_started_at IS NOT NULL
          AND s.ended_at IS NOT NULL
          AND s.next_started_at >= s.ended_at
          AND s.next_started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
          AND COALESCE(s.next_mrr, s.mrr) < s.mrr
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM subs s2
          WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
            AND s2.started_at < q.quarter_end
            AND (s2.ended_at IS NULL OR s2.ended_at >= q.quarter_end)
            AND s2.status = 'active'
      )
)
SELECT
    q.quarter_start::DATE AS most_recent_quarter_start,
    (q.quarter_end - INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE AS most_recent_quarter_end,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tc.customer_id) AS churned_customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id) AS customers_at_start_of_quarter,
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT tc.customer_id)::DOUBLE / COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id)
    END AS churn_rate
FROM quarter_bounds q
LEFT JOIN starting_customers sc ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN true_churns tc ON sc.customer_id = tc.customer_id
GROUP BY 1, 2;

WITH cancelled_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.plan,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at IS NOT NULL
), cancellation_classification AS (
    SELECT
        cs.*,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM fct_subscriptions s2
            WHERE s2.customer_id = cs.customer_id
              AND s2.status = 'active'
              AND s2.started_at BETWEEN cs.ended_at - INTERVAL '1 day' AND cs.ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
              AND COALESCE(s2.mrr, 0) < COALESCE(cs.mrr, 0)
        ) AS is_downgrade_cancellation
    FROM cancelled_subs cs
), customer_level_v1 AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) FILTER (WHERE c.churned_at IS NOT NULL) AS churned_customers_v1,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers_total
    FROM dim_customers c
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
), subscription_level_corrected AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_downgrade_cancellation = FALSE) AS true_churn_cancellations,
        COUNT(*) AS all_cancelled_subscriptions,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_downgrade_cancellation = TRUE) AS downgrade_cancellations
    FROM cancellation_classification
)
SELECT
    churned_customers_v1,
    customers_total,
    CAST(churned_customers_v1 AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(customers_total, 0) AS churn_rate_v1_customer_based,
    true_churn_cancellations,
    all_cancelled_subscriptions,
    downgrade_cancellations,
    CAST(true_churn_cancellations AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(all_cancelled_subscriptions, 0) AS true_churn_share_of_cancellations,
    'v1 was wrong because it likely used dim_customers.churned_at or raw cancellations without excluding downgrade-cancellations; canonical churn at the subscription grain should treat cancelled rows followed by a lower-MRR active subscription within 1 day as downgrades, not churn.' AS what_was_wrong_with_v1
FROM customer_level_v1
CROSS JOIN subscription_level_corrected;

WITH current_q AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('quarter', current_date) AS quarter_start
), quarter_windows AS (
    SELECT quarter_start, 'current' AS quarter_label FROM current_q
    UNION ALL
    SELECT quarter_start - INTERVAL '3 months', 'previous' AS quarter_label FROM current_q
), customer_churn_events AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.ended_at AS churned_at
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND c.is_test = FALSE
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM fct_subscriptions s2
          WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
            AND s2.status = 'active'
            AND s2.started_at >= s.ended_at - INTERVAL '1 day'
            AND s2.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
            AND s2.mrr < s.mrr
      )
), quarter_churns AS (
    SELECT
        qw.quarter_label,
        qw.quarter_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cce.customer_id) AS churned_customers
    FROM quarter_windows qw
    LEFT JOIN customer_churn_events cce
      ON cce.churned_at >= qw.quarter_start
     AND cce.churned_at < qw.quarter_start + INTERVAL '3 months'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
), quarter_starts AS (
    SELECT
        qw.quarter_label,
        qw.quarter_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS starting_customers
    FROM quarter_windows qw
    JOIN fct_subscriptions s
      ON s.started_at < qw.quarter_start
     AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= qw.quarter_start)
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled', 'paused')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    qc.quarter_label,
    qc.quarter_start,
    COALESCE(qs.starting_customers, 0) AS starting_customers,
    qc.churned_customers,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(qs.starting_customers, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE CAST(qc.churned_customers AS DOUBLE) / qs.starting_customers
    END AS churn_rate
FROM quarter_churns qc
LEFT JOIN quarter_starts qs
  ON qc.quarter_label = qs.quarter_label
 AND qc.quarter_start = qs.quarter_start
ORDER BY qc.quarter_start DESC;

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-03-31'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT
    period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue' THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals;

SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS revenue
FROM fct_invoices i
JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
WHERE (CASE
    WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
      THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'

  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id

    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT
    period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue' THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-03-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals;

  SELECT i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id

    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue' THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25)) / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals;

WITH starting AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
            AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-01-01')
            AND s.mrr > 0
          THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS arr_start
  FROM dim_customers c
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
ending AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN s.started_at < DATE '2026-03-31'
            AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-03-31')
            AND s.mrr > 0
          THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS arr_end
  FROM dim_customers c
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(LEAST(e.arr_end, s.arr_start))::FLOAT
    / NULLIF(SUM(s.arr_start), 0) * 100 AS gross_retention_pct
FROM starting s
JOIN ending e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.arr_start > 0;

model_sql:
WITH starting_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND s.status = 'active'
    AND s.started_at < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2025-01-01')
),
churned AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND c.churned_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS rev
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE
    (CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END) < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
)
SELECT
  ((revenue.rev / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0)) * 0.75)
    / NULLIF(churned.cust_count::DOUBLE / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0), 0)
    AS ltv
FROM starting_customers, churned, revenue;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 00:00:00' AS period_end
), open_opps AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.opp_id'), json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.oppId')) AS opp_id,
    CAST(COALESCE(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.deal_value'), json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.dealValue')) AS DOUBLE) AS deal_value
  FROM fct_events e
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE e.event_type = 'opp_created'
    AND timezone('UTC', timezone(COALESCE(e.timezone, 'UTC'), e."timestamp")) < p.period_end
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM fct_events e2
      WHERE COALESCE(json_extract_string(e2.properties_jsonb, '$.opp_id'), json_extract_string(e2.properties_jsonb, '$.oppId'))
          = COALESCE(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.opp_id'), json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.oppId'))
        AND e2.event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision')
        AND timezone('UTC', timezone(COALESCE(e2.timezone, 'UTC'), e2."timestamp")) < p.period_end
    )
)
SELECT SUM(deal_value) / 5000000.0 AS coverage_ratio
FROM open_opps;

WITH normalized_invoices AS (
  SELECT
    i.amount,
    CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END AS paid_at_la
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
), monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', paid_at_la) AS month_start,
    SUM(amount) AS revenue
  FROM normalized_invoices
  WHERE paid_at_la >= TIMESTAMP '2026-02-01 00:00:00'
    AND paid_at_la < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY 1
), feb AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(revenue, 0) AS revenue
  FROM monthly_revenue
  WHERE month_start = DATE '2026-02-01'
), mar AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(revenue, 0) AS revenue
  FROM monthly_revenue
  WHERE month_start = DATE '2026-03-01'
)
SELECT
  mar.revenue AS march_2026_revenue,
  feb.revenue AS february_2026_revenue,
  mar.revenue - feb.revenue AS mom_change,
  (mar.revenue - feb.revenue) / NULLIF(feb.revenue, 0) AS mom_growth_rate
FROM feb
CROSS JOIN mar;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start, DATE '2026-03-31' AS period_end
),
starting_cohort AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < p.period_start
    AND s.started_at < p.period_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.period_start)
),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= p.period_start
    AND c.churned_at < p.period_end
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)
   FROM starting_cohort sc
   WHERE sc.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM churned_in_period))::DOUBLE
  / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM starting_cohort), 0) * 100
  AS churn_rate_pct;

model_sql:
WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT 'current_quarter' AS period_label,
         DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start,
         DATE '2026-03-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AS period_end
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'previous_quarter' AS period_label,
         DATE '2025-10-01' AS period_start,
         DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_end
),
starting_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    q.period_label,
    c.customer_id
  FROM quarters q
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.is_test = false
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.signup_date < q.period_start
    AND s.started_at < q.period_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > q.period_start)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT
    q.period_label,
    c.customer_id
  FROM quarters q
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.is_test = false
  WHERE c.churned_at >= q.period_start
    AND c.churned_at < q.period_end
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
cohort_counts AS (
  SELECT period_label, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS starting_cohort_count
  FROM starting_cohort
  GROUP BY 1
),
churn_counts AS (
  SELECT sc.period_label, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id) AS churned_from_starting_cohort_count
  FROM starting_cohort sc
  JOIN churned_in_period cp
    ON sc.period_label = cp.period_label
   AND sc.customer_id = cp.customer_id
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  q.period_label,
  q.period_start,
  q.period_end - INTERVAL 1 DAY AS period_end,
  COALESCE(cc.churned_from_starting_cohort_count, 0) AS churned_from_starting_cohort_count,
  COALESCE(co.starting_cohort_count, 0) AS starting_cohort_count,
  COALESCE(cc.churned_from_starting_cohort_count, 0)::DOUBLE
    / NULLIF(COALESCE(co.starting_cohort_count, 0), 0) * 100 AS churn_rate_pct
FROM quarters q
LEFT JOIN cohort_counts co ON q.period_label = co.period_label
LEFT JOIN churn_counts cc ON q.period_label = cc.period_label
ORDER BY CASE q.period_label WHEN 'current_quarter' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

WITH quarterly_cohorts AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', COALESCE(s.started_at, c.signup_date, c.joined_dt)) AS cohort_quarter,
        c.customer_id
    FROM dim_customers c
    LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
churns AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', c.churned_at) AS churn_quarter,
        c.customer_id
    FROM dim_customers c
    WHERE c.churned_at IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
quarterly_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        qc.cohort_quarter,
        COUNT(DISTINCT qc.customer_id) AS cohort_size,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ch.customer_id) AS churned_count
    FROM quarterly_cohorts qc
    LEFT JOIN churns ch ON qc.customer_id = ch.customer_id
                        AND qc.cohort_quarter = ch.churn_quarter
    GROUP BY qc.cohort_quarter
)
SELECT
    cohort_quarter,
    ROUND(CAST(churned_count AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(cohort_size, 0), 4) AS churn_rate
FROM quarterly_metrics
WHERE cohort_quarter IN (
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE),
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months')
)
ORDER BY cohort_quarter DESC

WITH q1_2026_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    event_type,
    timestamp
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE timestamp >= '2026-01-01'::TIMESTAMP
    AND timestamp < '2026-04-01'::TIMESTAMP
    AND event_type IN ('opportunity_won', 'opportunity_lost')
),
win_loss_counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN event_type = 'opportunity_won' THEN 1 END) AS wins,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('opportunity_won', 'opportunity_lost') THEN 1 END) AS total_closed
  FROM q1_2026_events
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN total_closed > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * wins / total_closed, 2)
    ELSE 0
  END AS win_rate_pct
FROM win_loss_counts

WITH quarterly_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', c.churned_at) AS churn_quarter,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS churned_customers
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.churned_at IS NOT NULL
    AND c.is_test = false
  GROUP BY 1
),
active_customers AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', d.dt) AS quarter,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS active_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(
      DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 quarter'),
      DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE),
      INTERVAL '1 quarter'
    )) AS dt
  ) d
  WHERE c.signup_date <= d.dt
    AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at > d.dt)
    AND c.is_test = false
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  a.quarter,
  COALESCE(q.churned_customers, 0) AS churned_customers,
  a.active_count AS active_customers_at_start,
  ROUND(COALESCE(q.churned_customers, 0)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(a.active_count, 0), 4) AS churn_rate
FROM active_customers a
LEFT JOIN quarterly_metrics q ON a.quarter = q.churn_quarter
ORDER BY a.quarter DESC

FROM fct_subscriptions s

WHERE

  AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= m.month_start + INTERVAL '1 month')

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals
